See how our Ahrefs access works

What is Ahrefs Group Buy? How does it work?

Group Buy is a collective subscription. We have a premium Ahrefs account that members can use within a limit per day, for a small monthly fee. Like a car pool, everyone is in the same car, and each person pays their share of gas. As you open the real Ahrefs from our Chrome extension, you will get the exact same real-time backlinks and keywords data a paid user will access as well. NONE is ever sent to you and we never ask for yours. All members have 50 credits per day which reset every day and can be used for Site Explorer, backlink checker, Keywords Explorer and exports.

Ahrefs features included with your access

Available

  • Site Explorer — backlink profile, referring domains, anchor text, and broken backlinks for any domain
  • Backlink checker — check any site's backlinks and referring domains
  • Keywords Explorer — search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC, and SERP overview
  • Exports — included within your 50 daily credits

Not available

  • Rank Tracker
  • API access
  • Ahrefs account settings, billing, or user management

Before purchasing, you should need to know these 7 questions

Ahrefs has a whopping 35 trillion external backlinks for 287 million domains, and its keyword data includes 217 locations (Ahrefs Big Data). That many data makes difficult SEO questions easy. The following are the matters you can learn:

Who links to my competitor but not to me?

Open Site Explorer, and review the Referring domains report of each competitor. Download the lists and use Google Sheets to compare the lists. Your best outreach sites are those which connect to your rivals and avoid you, as they already connect to pages like yours.

Why is there a decrease in my traffic?

Check the organic traffic graph in Site Explorer. A dramatic drop on one day typically coincides with a Google update or a load of lost links. Just open the lost backlinks for that week and you'll most likely find out what's going on.

What should write next?

Open Top pages for opponent. You can view the articles that are attracting the most search traffic and the keywords used. Choose a topic that doesn't create any doubt and then write a longer and updated page about it.

An additional three fast checks

Broken links : Broken backlinks report shows the links that are leading to your dead pages, you can fix them. Ranking chances: Keywords Explorer gives the difficulty level of keywords ranging from 0 to 100 and indicates who is currently ranking. Guest post value: Domain Rating and traffic trend on a site indicates whether a link will be worth it to the guest post. Just one last piece of advice: If you have your city and/or country set in Keywords Explorer before you search, then the volumes will be aligned with your actual market.

4 Advanced Ahrefs Workflows Pros Use Every Week

Broken link building

Despite being a big site, pages get deleted regularly, and the links that go to those pages are lost. Open Site Explorer for a big website in your market, and filter for Pages with a 404 status code in Best by links. All of the sites that are connected to that dead page will be warm leads. Email them, let them know of the broken link and your working page as the solution. This will require approximately 3 credits.

Link gap outreach

This one is best done as a brief practice:
  • Get the referring domains for your two leading competitors.
  • Export your own referring domains.
  • In Google Sheets, add the sites that link to both of the competitors, but not to you.
  • Target those sites first, then pitch.
It will give you a list of sites that "like" your topic for about a 4 credit cost.

What is the best way to create a keyword cluster using only one credit?

If you need to paste more than 10,000 keywords, all at once, into Keywords Explorer, Ahrefs still charges 1 credit. Organize them by keyword popularity and eliminate terms that you can't currently get a hold of. Then cluster keywords that have the same pages as the best results. A single article can now be used for the whole group rather than one word.

Local competitor research

Local SEO starts with local links. A taco truck entrepreneur in Austin can observe that the Austin Chronicle and Do512 are linking to the top taco trucks on East 6th Street and that they are pitching the same sites to Austin's client. A dentist can be located in Park Slope, and they can have a check performed by a Brooklyn agency. Lahore freelancers close to Arfa Software Technology Park on Ferozepur Road employ this technique to create Fiverr audit reports for the UK and UAE clients. Define the client's country first, then all volumes are set to match their market.

What are Ahrefs Numbers and What do they Mean?

Most new users hang up at the metrics, not the tools. The score for your overall backlink profile is called Domain Rating (DR) and the score for a URL is URL Rating (UR) and both are rated from 0 to 100. The more the better, but only if compared against the rival's. Referrer Domains: These show the number of unique websites linking to a website. Total backlinks are not as important as this number, as having 10 links from 10 websites is more beneficial than having 10 links from 1 website. Here are a few more terms that you'll hear frequently:
  • Dofollow: a link that passes ranking value. If you don't want Google to follow links, you should use no follow links.
  • Keyword difficulty (KD): The difficulty of the top 10 (0-100).
  • Organic traffic: Approximate number of visitors traffic to the website arrives from Google in any given month. Look at it as an approximation and not actual analytics.
  • The monetary value of a traffic: what it would cost you to buy as Google Ads clicks.

Ahrefs Group Buy Questions

Below are the questions buyers ask us most often, from credits and safety to local keyword research.

What exactly is an Ahrefs group buy?

A cost-sharing setup: one provider manages premium Ahrefs accounts and gives many users controlled access through a managed system, splitting the subscription cost. You pay $20/month instead of buying an official plan.

Is the data the same as official Ahrefs?

Research results come from Ahrefs' own backlink and keyword datasets. What differs is availability: shared sessions, a 50-credit daily allowance, and no API, Rank Tracker, or account settings.

Is it safe to use?

You never receive the underlying Ahrefs login credentials; access runs through our managed Chrome extension system. Avoid entering sensitive client credentials or confidential information into any shared-access environment. One honest caveat: account sharing conflicts with Ahrefs' terms, so we back every purchase with a refund-or-replacement guarantee if access is ever interrupted.

Which features are limited?

Rank Tracker and API access aren't included, and account settings stay with us. Exports count toward your 50 daily credits. Day-to-day research — backlink checks, keyword research, and competitor analysis — is available within the stated usage limits.

How fast do I get access after paying?

Instant. You'll receive the extension access details on WhatsApp and email right after payment.

Does it work on mobile?

No — access runs through a Chrome extension on desktop. Use a desktop or laptop.

What happens if access stops working?

Message us on WhatsApp (24/7). If we can't restore it, you choose: a refund, or a replacement with any other tool from our website.

Can I share my access with someone else?

No — one user per subscription. Sharing may result in suspension.

Which subscription duration should I choose?

One week if you need Ahrefs for a short research project. One month for ongoing SEO work. The 3-, 6-, and 12-month plans bring the effective monthly price down to ≈ $18.33, ≈ $16.67, and $15.00 if you'll use the service continuously.

Are unused credits carried over?

No. The 50 credits will only be given again once a day, so you are better off using the same amount every day.

May I take advantage of it for local SEO?

Yes. In Keywords Explorer, you can set the country and learn the backlinks of local competitors through Site Explorer. The same steps apply to a plumber in Houston as well as a restaurant in Dubai.

Is it possible to export the data to Google Sheets or Excel?

Yes. It is exported in CSV format, and the number of exports earned will be counted against your daily credit.

Is it suitable for use for Fiverr clients or Upwork?

In fact, a lot of freelancers do, primarily for audits and link reports. In case a client has an official privacy arrangement, an official Ahrefs plan is better.

Ahrefs or Semrush: Which One Should You Open?

Both tools conduct keyword research and backlink checks, and thus buyers frequently question themselves on which one they truly require. The truth is, there's no one job that's best for each one. When links are the key question, open up Ahrefs. It demonstrates who connects to a website, and which links were broken and which pages get the majority of links, making it a top choice for backlink audits for many SEOs. Use Open Semrush when you require a competitor's Google Ads copy or any paid search data; when you require a full technical site audit with your own projects. For client audits, many freelancers utilize both: Ahrefs for the link profile and Semrush for ads and on page issues.

5 Mistakes That Waste Your Ahrefs Credits

The majority of wasted credits occur because of habits, rather than the tool itself. Be careful of the following:
  • Attaching filters to an open report.
  • Checking individual words, rather than typing the full list of keywords.
  • Understanding the volume of global search in one city when the client is selling in that city.
  • Evaluating links based solely on their DR. Having a DR 30 site on your topic is better than a DR 80 site off topic.
  • Entering sensitive information (such as passwords) or notes into a shared application.
